strings.tl: How do you do. You must be [HERO]-san. // I am Tiara, the priest of this church. I am pleased to meet you.

strings.en:
{1c:10}This is Kadmon-san. He is a priest who
serves God here at this church with me.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: This is Kadmon-san. He is a priest who serves God here at this church with me.
I have mourned the spirits of hundreds of warriors in this church. // Every one of them was a wonderful person...

あってのことだとは思いますし、
それに私が口出しすることは
出来ないのだけれど、{1a}でも、その決意に飲み{e08b}まれない

strings.en:
{1c:10}I do not know what reasons brought you
to this town, {10}-san.{1a}Of course, I imagine you came with great
resolve, and it is not my place to
interfere with that,{1a}but please do not let that resolve
swallow you...{1a}When you face battle, and when you run
up against hardship, if you have family or
a sweetheart at home waiting for
your return,{1a}please remember that person's face.
Please do not forget that there are
people who need you.{1a}Please remember that God's blessing
hand and the thoughts of those people
are always protecting you.{1a}Please do not make them wear a
sorrowful face...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: I do not know what reasons brought you to this town, [HERO]-san. // Of course, I imagine you came with great resolve, and it is not my place to interfere with that, // but please do not let that resolve swallow you... // When you face battle, and when you run up against hardship, if you have family or a sweetheart at home waiting for your return, // please remember that person's face. Please do not forget that there are people who need you. // Please remember that God's blessing hand and the thoughts of those people are always protecting you. // Please do not make them wear a sorrowful face...
Tiara-chan, come quick! Rosso's bad again...!
I understand! I will come at once! // [1][HERO]-san, all I can do is heal wounds, but please come by at any time. Now, if you will excuse me.
